title: Zesty Smoky Herb Tunisian Jalapeno Tagine
description: An aromatic and flavorful dish featuring the bold flavors of Tunisian cuisine, with the added kick of jalapeno peppers. This recipe makes a perfect centerpiece for a special occasion or a cozy dinner party.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large bamboo tray over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the jalapeno peppers and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the bamboo tray to the oven and braise for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cilantro, and serve hot.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
